title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week's spotlight is Neil Diamond's “Play Me” — the hushed 1971 ballad from the Stones album, built on one of his most personal lyrics: “You are the sun, I am the moon… you are the words, I am the tune — play me.” It creeps in on a spare piano line and swells into one of the most romantic choruses in his catalog. In a Djembe set it lands as the tender heart of the night — a slow-burn moment that pulls the room in close.
songListNote: Song of the Week — Neil Diamond's tender 1971 ballad “Play Me” joins the request catalog this week.
